tpl: <day>、<guest>が来[く]る前[まえ]に<prep>{ておきます|pt-teoku}。
en: <day>, before <guest> comes, I'll <prep> ahead of time.
why: Doing something beforehand, to be ready for a later event, is the te-form plus おく.

why: Leaving something in a state so that it stays that way for later is the te-form plus おく; as a request, ておいてください.
